items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Lady Bailey says that he never broke a drum head. Huh? Lady Bailey says he never broke a drum head.

ctx.x: And I ain't never broke a head. I've heard of people that right there.
And Lady Bailey says that he never broke a drum head. Huh? Lady Bailey says he never broke a drum head.
Well, I'll tell you, I ain't never broke a drum head. I said those are the same.
